name: staggered-glyph-cascade
title: Staggered Glyph Cascade
description: A dramatic entrance reveal splitting strings into glyphs that drop down like raindrops with slight pseudo-random angle jitter and spring settle.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Variable Poster
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Viewport Entrance Cycle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
